differences.title: 1. Initial Load
differences.leftDesc: Server sends pre-rendered HTML, faster initial paint.
differences.rightDesc: Server sends minimal HTML, JS hydrates for full content.

differences.title: 2. SEO
differences.leftDesc: Search engines easily crawl fully rendered content.
differences.rightDesc: Requires JS execution for crawlers, can be slower.

differences.title: 3. Interactivity
differences.rightDesc: Initial render may be slower, but updates are swift.

differences.title: 4. Bundle Size
differences.leftDesc: Less JavaScript needed on the client for initial render.
differences.rightDesc: More JavaScript required on the client for hydration.

differences.title: 5. Server Load
differences.leftDesc: Server processes and renders all initial pages.
differences.rightDesc: Server sends static assets, client does rendering.

differences.title: 6. Perceived Performance
differences.leftDesc: Users see content sooner, improving perceived speed.
differences.rightDesc: Users might wait longer for full interactivity.

differences.title: 7. State Management
differences.leftDesc: State managed on the server, needs serialization.
differences.rightDesc: State managed on the client, standard React patterns.
